data.notes: March 2027 is already anchored by Miami’s Latin street-festival season, GroundUP’s live-music weekend, and the Ultra/Miami Music Week electronic-music takeover, while individual club-party calendars are still largely unannounced.

events.title: Ultra Music Festival 2027
events.summary: Ultra Music Festival returns to Bayfront Park in Downtown Miami for three days, March 26-28, 2027. The official festival-info page confirms the daily hours and 18+ entry policy.

events.title: Miami Music Week 2027
events.venueName: Venues across Greater Miami and Miami Beach
events.summary: Miami Music Week is the citywide electronic-music week of DJ sets, pool parties, club events and industry gatherings, with the 2027 edition set for March 22-28 and Ultra as the closing-weekend anchor.

events.title: 49th Annual Calle Ocho Music Festival
events.summary: Carnaval Miami’s flagship Calle Ocho Music Festival takes over 15 blocks of Little Havana with music stages, food, folkloric dance and entertainment.

events.title: Don Omar - The Last King World Tour
events.summary: Reggaeton pioneer Don Omar brings The Last King World Tour to Kaseya Center on March 12.

events.title: Winter Music Conference 2027
events.summary: Winter Music Conference runs during Miami Music Week with WMC programming, networking mixers, two pool parties and access to WMC-sanctioned events.

events.title: Morat - YEM World Tour 2027
events.summary: Colombian pop band Morat brings the YEM World Tour 2027 to Kaseya Center on March 20.

events.title: GroundUP Music Festival 2027
events.summary: GroundUP returns to Miami Beach with Snarky Puppy performing full sets every night, plus Victoria Canal and Snarky Puppy Family Dinner with special guests.

events.title: Winter Party Festival 2027
events.venueName: Miami Beach / National Hotel Miami Beach
events.summary: Long-running LGBTQ+ circuit and dance-music festival returning to Miami Beach for its 34th year, with a host hotel/pool-party hub at the National Hotel and a multi-day program of beach, pool and night parties.

events.title: Jay Wheeler - La Voz Favorita Tour
events.summary: Puerto Rican singer Jay Wheeler brings his La Voz Favorita world tour to Kaseya Center for a Miami arena date.

events.title: Laura Pausini - Yo Canto Tour
events.summary: Italian global pop singer Laura Pausini brings her Yo Canto Tour to Hard Rock Live on March 14.

events.title: Death Cab For Cutie - I Built You A Tower Tour
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at Jackie Gleason Theater
events.summary: Death Cab for Cutie plays The Fillmore Miami Beach on the I Built You A Tower Tour, with Swapmeet listed on the bill.

events.title: Carnaval on the Mile 2027
events.summary: Carnaval Miami’s Coral Gables weekend features local art, live music, food and family programming on Miracle Mile. The 2027 entertainment lineup is still listed as coming soon.

events.title: Rod Stewart
events.summary: Rod Stewart performs at Hard Rock Live in Hollywood, a major South Florida concert venue just north of Miami.

events.title: 28th Annual Carnaval on the Mile
events.summary: Free two-day Carnaval Miami street festival on Miracle Mile with multiple concert stages, Latin/Caribbean community focus, jazz, funk, local art and food programming.

events.title: STAMPED: AYA & Friends - Ghana Independence
events.summary: Ghana Independence edition of STAMPED, a recurring Miami rooftop party centered on African-continent sounds, with highlife, amapiano and afrobeats programmed by AYA and friends.

events.title: The Cleveland Orchestra Miami Residency 2027: March Concerts
events.venueName: Knight Concert Hall, Adrienne Arsht Center
events.summary: The Cleveland Orchestra’s Miami Residency expands in March with three confirmed Arsht Center concerts: The Music of John Williams on March 12, Rachmaninoff’s Rhapsody on March 13 and Szeps-Znaider Plays Bruch on March 20.

events.title: Cristian Castro: Nada Solo Éxitos Tour 2027
events.summary: Mexican Latin-pop vocalist Cristian Castro brings the Nada Solo Éxitos Tour 2027 to the James L. Knight Center on March 13, 2027 at 8:00 PM.
